rows.why: Medi used connector إنها instead of conditional إذا ('let's see if I did them right'); Amal prompts with إنه or إذا.
rows.english: let's see if I did them right

rows.medi_said: مش بدي تشت-- أشتغل ست أيام.
rows.why: Negation of pseudo-verb biddi requires ma (ما بدي), not mish; Amal let it pass.
rows.english: I don't want to work six days

rows.medi_said: أنا أخذت وقت إضافه لـ قهوة
rows.why: Medi used Fusha/Farsi إضافة for extra/more time; Amal explains at 10:22 that in spoken Arabic we say زيادة.
Medi used 3andi to say 'my first time'; Amal corrects that 'my first' takes eli (أول مرة إلي) and 3andi is only used with mufaddal.
Medi paired masculine el-awwal with feminine noun el-marra; Amal recasts to المرة الأولى (which Medi acknowledges at 21:00).

rows.medi_said: el mara el thani, yeah, is also second time.
rows.why: Medi used masculine thani after feminine noun el-marra without feminine ending; Amal let it pass during explanation.

rows.medi_said: aglab el marra is most of the time.
rows.amal_said: Yeah, but we don't say that. So أغلب الوقت.
rows.why: Medi translated 'most of the time' literally as aglab el marra; Amal explicitly rejects it and gives أغلب الوقت.
Medi added preposition min ('awal minna') for 'the beginning of it'; Amal rejects with 'No' and guides to awwalo / awwalha.

rows.amal_said: If you take out the L even, it's wrong. Akhir shantata means like the end of her bag.
rows.why: Medi placed aa5er before the noun for 'her last bag', which means 'the end of her bag'; Amal explains the adjective must follow the noun.
Medi put el- on shanta after aa5er ('آخر الشنتة لها'); Amal recasts to 'آخر شنطة إلها' without el-.
rows.english: her last bag (last bag of hers)

rows.why: Medi said 'آخر البرنامج لنا' instead of attaching possessive -na to the noun ('آخر برنامجنا'); Amal rejects with 'No' and recasts at 35:16.

rows.amal_said: No. ... It means the beginning of their cat.
rows.why: Medi placed awal before the definite possessed noun ('أول بستهم', engine wrote بسيطًا); Amal rejects and explains it means 'the beginning of their cat'.
Medi produced an incorrect plural noun form with possessive ('أسيليك'); Amal prompts and provides أسألتك at 42:31.
Medi used preposition min with ghayr ('ghayr minni') for 'different from me'; Amal says 'No' and provides 3an (غير عني).

rows.medi_said: This will be راح يكون الـأخر-- Uh, الـأخر مرة
rows.amal_said: Only one correction is مرة، مرة is feminine or masculine. So راح شو؟
rows.why: Medi used masculine راح يكون referring to feminine subject آخر مرة; Amal prompts for gender match and Medi fixes to راح تكون.
rows.english: it will be the last time

rows.why: Medi omitted b- prefix on present verb ('أعملها', engine wrote أملها); Amal recasts to بعملها with b-.
rows.english: the last time I do it

rows.amal_said: You don't need منكون، خلص، بس سيئين.
rows.why: Medi inserted present form of 'to be' ('نكون') and singular 'سيء'; Amal corrects that Arabic drops 'to be' in plain present and requires plural adjective سيئين.
Medi negated 3indna with mish; Amal recasts to ما عنا (ma with pseudo-verbs).
rows.english: we don't have a lot of time

rows.medi_said: بس راح، راح بنفتح ... راح بنـ، بنطفأ.
rows.why: Medi kept the b- prefix after future particle ra7 ('راح بندفع', engine wrote بنطفأ); Amal prompts with 'راح' and recasts to bare verb ندفع.

rows.medi_said: إذا بنـ-- نطفا كتير بدنا إشي ممتاز و special.
rows.amal_said: What's special? You know it. ... مميز.
rows.why: Medi dropped English 'special' into an Arabic sentence; sheet has 'special | Mumayyaz | مميز' and Amal prompts and supplies it at 58:52.
Medi omitted preposition 3ala after متأخرين; Amal recasts with على (متأخرين على أول طيارة).
rows.english: we will be late for the first flight

rows.why: Medi used non-existent feminine form شهرة for masculine month (شهر); Amal recasts to شهر.

rows.medi_said: قبل شهر، uh, ما، ما استعملت، um, اسباني كتير.
rows.amal_said: Do, do you wanna say the last month؟ ... الشهر الماضي.
rows.why: Medi used قبل شهر (a month ago) when he meant 'the past month'; Amal prompts and corrects to الشهر الماضي.

rows.medi_said: شهر الماضي ما استعملت اسباني كتير.
rows.why: Medi omitted el- on the noun in the definite noun-adjective phrase 'الشهر الماضي'; Amal let it pass.
